comment_regular: Samples every morph-target interpolator and writes the resulting floats into morphWeights (+0x40; data +0x44, size +0x4A). Although the ABI consumes one float stack argument (retn 4), the native body does not read it: interpolation uses the controller's cached time at NiTimeController +0x28. Callers pass that same cached value. This is controller time, not a direct morph weight.
